# cogNNitive — LLM context

## About
cogNNitive turns ideas, insights, and data scattered through human brains and computer files into a living, structured knowledge base powered by AI. This site is the bootstrap entry point: it tells AI agents what skills to install, where to download them, and what workflows are available.

## Key repos

- cogNNitive: https://github.com/cogNNitive/cogNNitive — monorepo: iNNfo specification engine (parser, validator, MCP server), agent skills, iNNfo Modeler app, and this site

## Bootstrap
1. Install OpenCode from https://opencode.ai/download
2. Tell your agent: "I want to use https://cognnitive.com/use"
3. Choose what you want to do and follow the instructions

## Manifest file
docs/use/manifest.md (YAML frontmatter contains the agent-bootstrap block with skills, templates, and workflows)
